## TypedNil interface

An upstream interface containing a nil pointer of a concrete syntax.Node kind. This differs from a nil interface (null): the concrete Go type remains observable and can affect operations. Only interface-valued positions admit this tag; concrete pointer fields use null. No record fields or node bounds are stored on the tag.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface TypedNil<
  ConcreteKind extends
    | 'ArithmCmd'
    | 'ArithmExp'
    | 'ArrayElem'
    | 'ArrayExpr'
    | 'Assign'
    | 'BinaryArithm'
    | 'BinaryCmd'
    | 'BinaryTest'
    | 'Block'
    | 'BraceExp'
    | 'CStyleLoop'
    | 'CallExpr'
    | 'CaseClause'
    | 'CaseItem'
    | 'CmdSubst'
    | 'Comment'
    | 'CoprocClause'
    | 'DblQuoted'
    | 'DeclClause'
    | 'ExtGlob'
    | 'File'
    | 'FlagsArithm'
    | 'ForClause'
    | 'FuncDecl'
    | 'IfClause'
    | 'LetClause'
    | 'Lit'
    | 'ParamExp'
    | 'ParenArithm'
    | 'ParenTest'
    | 'ProcSubst'
    | 'Redirect'
    | 'SglQuoted'
    | 'Stmt'
    | 'Subshell'
    | 'TestClause'
    | 'TestDecl'
    | 'TimeClause'
    | 'UnaryArithm'
    | 'UnaryTest'
    | 'WhileClause'
    | 'Word'
    | 'WordIter',
> 
```
